units.text: When comparing two large directory structures, one of which was originally copied from the other with timestamps preserved (e.g., with ‘⟦0⟧’), it would greatly improve performance if an option told ⟦1⟧ to assume that two files with the same size and timestamps have the same content. See ⟦2⟧⟦3⟧ Performance Tradeoffs⟦4⟧.
units.sourceHTML: When comparing two large directory structures, one of which was originally copied from the other with timestamps preserved (e.g., with ‘cp -pR’), it would greatly improve performance if an option told diff to assume that two files with the same size and timestamps have the same content. See diff Performance Tradeoffs.
